title: US-Iran Ceasefire Collapses — Trump Declares Deal 'Over' After Hormuz Tanker Attacks
detail: The 60-day US-Iran ceasefire fell apart after Iran attacked commercial vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz without prior clearance from the US-brokered framework. Speaking on the sidelines of the NATO summit in Ankara, President Trump declared the ceasefire deal with Iran 'over,' calling Iranian counterparts 'scum' and 'sick people.' The US responded with a fresh wave of strikes on eastern Iranian cities including Bandar Abbas, Bushehr, and Chabahar, hitting roughly 80–90 military targets over two nights. The core dispute centers on conflicting interpretations of the June memorandum of understanding: Iran claims sole authority to arrange safe passage through the Strait and justifies attacks on vessels it did not clear, while the US insists the waterway must remain open to all commercial traffic. Global oil prices surged more than 9% on the news.

media.caption: President Trump addresses the collapse of the Iran ceasefire at the NATO summit in Ankara
